goal: Implement the core Pomodoro timer engine with state transitions, in-place terminal updates, and SIGINT handling.
architecture: The engine is centered around the `Timer` struct in `timer.go`, using `Clock` and `io.Writer` interfaces for testability. Transitions and updates are driven by a loop in `Timer.Run` that reacts to clock ticks and context cancellation.
review_focus: SIGINT handling precisely clearing the line (S9, S10, S11)
Correct session counting (interrupted sessions not counted) (S6, S22)
Correct transition logic for the 4-session cycle (S1, S2, S16)
ANSI escape sequence accuracy for in-place updates (S5, S7, S14)
Validation of durations at startup (S4, S12, S13, S19)

boundaries.fake: testClock provides manual advancement of time
notifyWriter records all writes to a slice for assertion
bytes.Buffer used to capture output in unit tests

tasks.title: Timer Loop and Transitions

scenarios.check: After 4 focus sessions, the next break is a long break.
Timer transitions correctly through Focus, ShortBreak, and LongBreak in the 4-session cycle.
Timer handles 1-minute durations correctly without negative countdowns.
After a long break, the cycle restarts at session 5.

spec_excerpt: The timer must transition between focus sessions, short breaks, and long breaks according to the four-session cycle logic
The timer must update the in-place status line every second using carriage return and ANSI erase-to-end-of-line
tasks.notes: Implement the Run loop using a select on Clock.After and context.Done. Ensure transition logic increments completedFocus and handles the 4-session logic (modulo 4).

tasks.title: Output Formatting
tasks.notes: Implement updateOutputFn to format the duration as MM:SS and include the ANSI escape sequence.

tasks.title: Interrupt Handling

scenarios.check: Interrupting 1s before completion does not count the session.

spec_excerpt: On SIGINT, the program must clear the current in-place status line, print exactly 'Completed N focus sessions\n' where N counts only fully finished focus sessions, and exit with status 0
tasks.notes: Implement handleSIGINTFn to clear the line using \r\x1b[K and print the completed count.

tasks.title: Completion Message Logic

scenarios.check: Long break interrupted prints correct count.
SIGINT clears the current line before printing completion.

spec_excerpt: The writer first receives '\r\x1b[K' to clear the 'Session 3: 05:00' remnant, then 'Completed 2 focus sessions\n'.
tasks.notes: Implement runCompletion to use the ANSI clear sequence and format the message with the completed count.

tasks.title: Flag Validation
spec_excerpt: The program must validate that each configured duration... does not exceed 24 hours at startup
tasks.notes: Implement validateFlagsFn to check durations against the 24h limit and the 1s minimum, returning exit code 1 on failure.
